text_block_list.text: Hey! Hey! How did I do?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yay! ♪ So, do you feel better
now?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yay! ♪ So, do you feel better
now?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
She's doing great both on social media
and
improving her running. With that in
mind, I guess
there was nothing to worry
about...

...I'm super happy you were thinking
about me,
though. Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: And now for Umastagram...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
These comments are looking good. ♪
You should
check them out too!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
These comments are looking good. ♪
You should
check them out too!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Urged by a seemingly satisfied Curren
Chan, I
look at her Umastagram.

"I just saw you race for the first time. It
was
awesome!"
"You're so cute, Curren
Chan! I just followed you!"
"I'm looking
forward to your next race. ♪"

I'm getting more comments, and they're
actually
watching my races! I guess this is
the result of all
that promotion!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I might actually be able to race my way
to being
the most beloved runner... ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
We've just got back from Kyoto and are
on our
way back to the academy, when...
Hey? Is that...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: It's Flaaash! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Curren. Good afternoon. Or perhaps I
should say
good evening.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Either's fine with me. ♪ You sure are
precise.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
(Эйсин Флэш. She debuted around the
same time
as Каррен Тян and is
currently lighting up the
Classics.)
Are you... out jogging right now?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have a race approaching, so I'm
making my
final preparations.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, she's running in
the
Japanese Derby tomorrow.
Considering the time,
she ought to be
resting.

...It's true that I should be resting right
now in
preparation for the race.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: So... why aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...This is embarrassing to admit, but I
can't seem
to control my emotions.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
If I do nothing, I become rather nervous.
I
received permission to do some light
jogging, so
here I am.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Really? ...But you're always so calm. Isn't
this
strange?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yes, normally I would strictly adhere to
my
schedule...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But tomorrow is the Japanese Derby.
It's...
special.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Many people dream of running there.

text_block_list.text:
She ran well in the Satsuki Sho just
before this.
Still, I can understand being
on edge with the
Japanese Derby just
ahead.
Hmmm...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
We have been standing and talking for
quite a
while. I need to add 3 minutes
and 36 seconds to
my jog.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I should get back to my exercise. Please
be
careful on your way home.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ah, right. Good luck in tomorrow's race!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян stares after Эйсин Флэш for
quite
some time after she's run off.
...Big Bro?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: ...Big Sis?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I wanna go watch the Derby tomorrow.
I... feel
like I have to.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I think we're supposed to have the day
off
tomorrow, but... do you mind?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Thanks.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Let's go to Tokyo Racecourse!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
